testWorking.subtitle: How It Works
testWorking.title: See It In Action
testWorking.step1Desc: Prick your finger with the lancet and place a small drop of blood on the test strip.
testWorking.step2Desc: The blood naturally flows along the test strip through capillary action, picking up special markers as it moves.
testWorking.step3Desc: As the blood moves through the strip, coloured lines appear — showing whether a health marker is detected.
testWorking.step4Desc: Match the line on the test strip with the shade card to understand your result — it's that simple.
